answer_1.quote: We focus on generative commonsense reasoning, or CommonGen, which involves generating logical sentences describing an everyday scenario from a set of concepts.
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural language sentences from input concept sets.

answer_2.quote: We use a gamut of automatic evaluation metrics. These include those used by [Lin et al. (2020)], such as BLEU, CIDEr, SPICE, and Coverage (Cov). ... We also introduce BERTScore...

answer_4.quote: We ask annotators to evaluate 48 test CG examples from the human references, baseline outputs, and various method (excluding MI) outputs for BART-large and T5-base.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate fluency and commonsense on 1-5 scales.
